ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota Medicaid program to identify potential fraudulent activities.
questions: How much money is involved in the Medicaid fraud?
Who are the key players in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify potential fraudulent activities and track the flow of funds to determine who is involved and how much money is at stake.
